sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: very strong calcium identity. This is one of the cleanest reasons cheese still performs well inside dairy despite its drawbacks. Protein density is strong. Cheddar clearly still delivers on the protein side of dairy. Very practical and versatile. It is genuinely easy to use in lots of foods.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: saturated fat is a major drawback. This is the biggest reason cheddar is not an easy elite dairy food. Energy density is harsh. Calories add up quickly compared with cleaner dairy anchors. Easy to overeat. Highly palatable and dense enough to add up fast.
